title: Make Claude Code Stop Sounding Like AI
description:
Claude Code's writing often screams "an AI wrote this," and the humanizer skill fixes that. Point it at any text you want to sound human, like an email, a reply, or a social media post, and it flags the words and patterns that give AI away, then rewrites it to read more naturally.

It catches recycled words, drops the em dash Claude Code loves to overuse, and cleans up the tells so your output doesn't read as AI-generated. 

Simple skill, and one I use all the time.

#techwithtim #ai #aiengineer #programming
